column1: # Cited-answer questions for the shared corpus (30 CFR Chapter I): qid<TAB>kind<TAB>question<TAB>gold docids.
# Kind "in" questions are answered in the gold sections (comma-separated); "out" questions (gold -) are not answered anywhere in the corpus, so a good system declines them.

column3: Within how many minutes must a mine operator call MSHA after an accident that kills a miner?
What minimum incombustible content must the combined dust in an underground coal mine keep where no methane is present?
How long must the self-rescue device given to each underground coal miner be able to protect that person?
How often must an underground metal or nonmetal mine hold evacuation drills?
How many hours of training must a new underground miner receive before being assigned to work duties?
What is the permissible exposure level for noise at a mine, as an 8-hour average?
How high must berms or guardrails be on the banks of roadways at metal and nonmetal mines?
For how many hours must the breathable air in an approved refuge alternative sustain each person?
What must a written bloodborne pathogens exposure control plan contain under OSHA?
At what depth does OSHA require a construction trench to have a protective system such as shoring or a trench box?
What FAA certification does a pilot need to fly a drone over a mine site?
When does a mine need an EPA stormwater discharge permit for runoff from its site?
